hidden.pipeline: one process per size; two opposite-order passes of 120 queries
hidden.latency: two serial fresh-process repeats per size, 120 fixed 40ms inputs + 40 stress 1ms inputs, 100 warm hidden show calls
hidden.controls: two repeats per size: NSSearchField vs NSTextField with separate stage/no-op probes; task vs dispatch delivery using the same probe workload
hidden.full_graph: two serial fresh persisted-index repeats per fixture size; one Projects read-only run; each idle window 64 seconds, busy interval repeated once

visible.planned: two serial repeats per size/workload, >=100 fixed inputs and warm shows; fresh-process cold; one opaque/vibrancy pair in opposite order; capture-on/off paired internal timings

censoring: every event retained; completed-only percentiles are conditional and never qualify a budget with missing events
concurrency: no other agent-run builds/tests/measurements while timing; shared machine activity uncontrolled
